highlights.text: “Is God troubled?” And her companion replied: “The sins of this universe would trouble anyone.” Leto heard them and wept silently.
The problem of leadership is inevitably: Who will play God?
That universe which you say you see and feel, that universe is my dream. My energies focus upon it and I am in any realm and every realm. Thus, you are born.
“Duncan, have I not told you that when you think you know something, that is a most perfect barrier against learning?”
“What good are laws and prisons when the breaking of a law is not a sin?”

“And look what you’ve done with that Empire!” “I have set up a pattern in it, a pattern of patterns.” “So you say.” “Information is frozen in patterns, Duncan. We can use one pattern to solve another pattern.
“I preserve life while setting the stage for the next cycle.” “You preserve it by killing?” “Death has often been useful to life.”

“He has been breeding us for a long time, Duncan, strengthening many things in us. He has bred us for speed, for intelligence, for self-restraint, for sensitivity. You’re . . . you’re just an older model.”

“The bright shadows of my pasts,” Leto said. “They never leave me in peace. I listened for a soothing sound, the bell of a country town at nightfall, and it told me only that I am the sound and soul of this place.”

“Tell me, old worm, is there a monster penis hidden in that monster body of yours? What a shock for the gentle Hwi!” “I told you the truth about that long ago,” Leto said. “Nobody tells the truth,” Malky husked. “You often told me the truth,” Leto said. “Even when you didn’t know it.”
